title: refactor: unify fallback outcome tracking
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reconstructs the fallback tracking simplification on current main instead of rebasing the stale implementation.
- Records every provider attempt in one ordered trace; the settling candidate now drives provider/model attribution, cost, fallback status, and community reward ownership.
- Removes the separate servedModelEntry state and modality-specific writes across text, image/video, audio, embeddings, and 3D.
- Preserves per-model fallback statuses, per-candidate RPM gates, cache and detached execution behavior, caller pricing, private fallback rewards, and overdrawn-credit safeguards.

Validation:
- Gen typecheck and Biome
- 1,330 tests passed across the full Gen suite; 6 skipped
- Focused billing, terminal failure, cache/detached, and local RPM-gate regressions

gist.headline: Every fallback leaves tracks
gist.blurb: The hive now keeps one orderly trail for every provider it visits. Whichever flower finally delivers the goods gets the credit, cost, and reward attached to its name.
gist.summary: Unified fallback tracking across text, image/video, audio, embeddings, and 3D into one ordered provider-attempt trace, with the successful settling candidate determining provider/model attribution, cost, fallback status, and community reward ownership.
gist.impact: Users and community model operators get more accurate generation attribution, pricing, fallback reporting, and reward ownership while preserving cache, detached execution, per-candidate RPM gates, and credit safeguards.
gist.visual_concept: Depict fallback routing as a cozy garden path through several small provider flower stations, each leaving a tiny labeled trail marker; Polli follows the full route with a clipboard and gives the final blooming station a clear credit ribbon. The visual metaphor is that every attempt is recorded, but the provider that successfully settles the generation receives the attribution and pollen reward.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing tiny accountant glasses and holding a clipboard as she follows an ordered trail through pastel provider-flower stations; the final blooming station receives a lime green (#ecf874) ribbon reading "SETTLED" while earlier stations have small trace markers.
